batch_name: 星露谷 Q 版主角四方向走/跑/idle 帧

canvas.ground_shadow: not baked — kernel drawPlayer() already draws elliptical shadow at feet (sx,sy); sprites contain no baked shadow

anchor.description: feet / bottom-center of canvas, zero drift across all 36 frames
anchor.draw_convention: drawImage(img, -width/2, -height) with translate(feet_world_x, feet_world_y) — same as current kernel

walk.note: down/up frames AI-painted; left = AI-painted side profile; right = exact horizontal mirror of left (symmetric by design)

run.note: forward-leaning, longer stride vs walk; right = mirror of left

idle.note: single standing frame; kernel idle bob handled in code (bob = -sin(idleT*1.8))

character.identity: chibi schoolgirl: short dark-brown bob hair with bangs, beige-khaki hoodie with hood on shoulders, light blue pleated mini skirt, white sneakers with dark-blue soles
character.proportion: head ~1/3 of total height, tiny body, short limbs

kernel_wiring_notes.running_frames: when player.running, select frames from <dir>_run_<f>.png instead of walk; frame index still floor(player.phase)%4
kernel_wiring_notes.anchor: unchanged — bottom-center feet anchor matches current drawImage(-fw/2, -fh)
kernel_wiring_notes.dust: keep existing procedural dust particles; no dust sprite asset needed
kernel_wiring_notes.existing_kernel_bob_and_run_tilt: keep — bob amp and rotate(±0.14)/scale(1.05,0.92) still apply on top of new frames
